description: Precommitted deterministic plateau-boundary probe. WIP attacks with 700 T6 Marksmen and no heroes; minxxx defends with 9 T6 Infantry and 700 T6 Lancers and no heroes. Using the supplied 2dp stats plus minxxx's stated hidden +2pp Attack/Defense, the simulator predicts minxxx wins with exactly 502 Lancers. Counts 8 and 9 are the same upper plateau because the Infantry line survives round 1 and consumes WIP's round-2 attack. The boundary is predicted between 7 and 8 Infantry.
